run_calculate_runner: run a CalculateRunner to execute calculations using an ASE calculator and save results to a directory
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a CalculateRunner subclass to perform custom calculations with job sharding
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a CalculateRunner subclass to save calculation output to files
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved calculation state from a checkpoint directory to resume an interrupted job
create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results for a custom ASE calculator workflow
